description: Loggers named with dots (`shop.payments`) form a hierarchy; `getLogger(name)` returns the same object for the same name.
A record is passed to the handlers of its logger and then of each ancestor while `propagate` is true.
Sends records somewhere (a stream, a file, a queue) and has its own level, filters and formatter.
Decides whether a record passes and may modify it; on a logger it does not see records propagated from children.
Adds attributes to the `LogRecord`; keys the record already uses raise `KeyError`.
User text with line breaks that forges extra log lines; escape it or write structured output.
